description: This file is a script written in JavaScript (Node.js) that analyzes source code to find specific call expressions related to 'agentCommand'. It imports modules for path handling, TypeScript AST parsing, and utilities for collecting call lines and running as a script. It defines functions to identify legacy agent command call lines, and executes a guard function to process source files and report findings about ingress call sites with specific conditions.

methods.name: findLegacyAgentCommandCallLines
methods.description: Analyzes source code content to locate call expressions where the callee is 'agentCommand', using TypeScript AST parsing.
